name: Foxfire

card.plain: Launch a slow fox flame that drifts across the screen.
Lv 1 -> Lv 2: you can keep two flames on screen at once.
card.frames: Lv 1 -> Lv 2: max flames on screen 1 -> 2

2.notes: Proposed (open question). Changes how you fight: stagger two flames to cover a jump. Alternative if the designer prefers a numeric step: recovery -10.

notes: ONE file serves both fighters: source kitsune (A8), slot C so Ryo can draft it into C and the Tanuki can copy it (T0); data identical for whoever casts it (K3). Clip kitsune-foxfire (49 frames, hit 16-19) has the same 49 frames and hit window as Ryo's ryo-foxfire-cast, so this one file fits both rigs. 15/4/30 = A table, no deviation. Active 4 is the release window; the flame spawns on frame 16 at the hand (about 50 cm = 100 units forward, chest height); the projectile, not the body, carries the hit. Blend-out: hand at about 80% at the cut, blend the last 4-6 ticks. Projectile speed 5 units/tick (slow, proposed). Body hurtbox only: sleeves not added. Damage 70 from the A table; hitstun/blockstun are placeholders. Lv 2 and EX remain proposed. YOK-33: boxes re-placed from the rigged model poses on their frames (bones at 200 u/m, +pads); frame timing unchanged.
